sec.title: September 4 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 726)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial story metadata declarations, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 4** across two generations of BBC Radio 4's rapid-fire panel game *Just a Minute* hosted by Nicholas Parsons (1982 with Kenneth Williams and 2000 with Paul Merton), daytime drama serial storylines on *Hearts in Harmony* for Kroger and *Young Widder Brown* for Bayer Aspirin, and Cold War international espionage with Ted Jewett on *John Steele, Adventurer*, Nicholas Parsons (1982, 2000), Jone Allison (1946, 1947), Florence Freeman (1950), and Ted Jewett (1946–2000):
